description: Right open palm directly in front of the face; wrist wave; smooth lift and return.
Same front-of-face gesture with the left hand; mirror X and wrist roll, not Y/Z.
Actual two-finger peace sign directly in front of the face, with a wink.
Peace sign beside the right cheek, leaving the centre of the face visible.
Both hands in front of the lower face; keep them separated so thumbs do not overlap.
The palm follows the face while the head and torso turn; do not compensate with arm Euler guesses.
Hand over the hoodie using chest-relative coordinates; leave room for the fabric volume.
Hold a palm at a fixed model-space position as the head turns. World means avatar metres, not desktop pixels.
Reach forward from the chest with an open palm, within the physical arm length.
Point toward the viewer's left: right hand, negative X position, positive 90-degree wrist roll.
All five supported hand shapes. Each segment lowers the hand before changing its shape.
Nod and sway through head, neck, spine, chest and shoulders while preserving the resting arms.
Closed-mouth puff with eyes open, then a soft smile. Explicitly release mouth_close at the end.
Face palette: choose or combine expressions; this sequence demonstrates the channels without moving the hands.
Manual silent mouth acting only. Normal speech already drives the mouth from PCM amplitude; do not replace that.
Advanced legacy bone-space pose beside the face. Individual finger bones work here because no hands target owns this arm. For positional gestures use hand_target.
Anticipate, do a peace sign, return, then wave. Reset each segment's weight rather than jumping between poses.
An actual VRM jump: hips translation, bent knees, takeoff, airborne lift and soft landing. Customize height and expressions; the portrait reserves headroom automatically.
Direct frame() protocol with explicit pacing and a neutral final frame. Use animate() for ordinary scripts.
